mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_usage(id, usage_no, user_coupon_id, user_id, checkout_batch_id, payment_order_id, eligible_rent_amount_fen, discount_amount_fen, cost_bearer_snapshot, usage_status, lock_expire_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{usage.id}, #{usage.usageNo}, #{usage.userCouponId}, #{usage.userId}, #{usage.checkoutBatchId}, #{usage.paymentOrderId}, #{usage.eligibleRentAmountFen}, #{usage.discountAmountFen}, #{usage.costBearerSnapshot}, 'locked', #{usage.lockExpireAt}, #{usage.createdAt}, #{usage.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO coupon_allocation(id, coupon_usage_id, checkout_batch_id, checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id, factory_id, sku_id, eligible_rent_amount_fen, allocated_discount_amount_fen, cost_bearer_snapshot, allocation_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{allocation.id}, #{allocation.usageId}, #{allocation.batchId}, #{allocation.snapshotId}, #{allocation.factoryId}, #{allocation.skuId}, #{allocation.eligibleRentFen}, #{allocation.discountFen}, 'shared_by_settlement_ratio', 'locked', #{allocation.at}, #{allocation.at})

INSERT INTO order_price_adjustment(id, checkout_batch_id, factory_id, adjustment_type, fund_component, adjustment_direction, amount_fen, source_type, source_id, adjustment_status, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{adjustment.id}, #{adjustment.batchId}, #{adjustment.factoryId}, 'coupon', 'rent', 'discount', #{adjustment.discountFen}, 'user_coupon', #{adjustment.couponId}, 'applied', #{adjustment.snapshotJson}, #{adjustment.at}, #{adjustment.at})

INSERT INTO coupon_operation_log(id, operation_request_id, user_coupon_id, coupon_usage_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, biz_type, biz_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{log.id}, #{log.requestId}, #{log.couponId}, #{log.usageId}, #{log.operation}, #{log.fromStatus}, #{log.toStatus}, #{log.operatorType}, #{log.actor}, 'checkout_batch', #{log.batchId}, #{log.reason}, #{log.at})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, usage_no, user_coupon_id, user_id, checkout_batch_id, payment_order_id, eligible_rent_amount_fen, discount_amount_fen, cost_bearer_snapshot, usage_status, lock_expire_at, used_at, released_at, return_confirmed_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM coupon_usage WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET coupon_status='used', used_at=#{now}, locked_until=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND coupon_status='locked'
UPDATE coupon_usage SET usage_status='used', used_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND usage_status='locked'

UPDATE coupon_allocation a JOIN rental_order_item i ON i.checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id=a.checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id SET a.rental_order_id=i.rental_order_id, a.rental_order_item_id=i.id, a.allocation_status='effective', a.updated_at=#{now} WHERE a.checkout_batch_id=#{batch} AND a.allocation_status='locked'

UPDATE order_price_adjustment a JOIN rental_order o ON o.checkout_batch_id=a.checkout_batch_id AND o.factory_id=a.factory_id SET a.rental_order_id=o.id, a.updated_at=#{now} WHERE a.checkout_batch_id=#{batch} AND a.rental_order_id IS NULL

UPDATE user_coupon SET coupon_status=CASE WHEN valid_until>#{now} THEN 'available' ELSE 'expired' END, locked_until=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND coupon_status='locked'

UPDATE user_coupon SET coupon_status='returned', returned_at=#{now}, valid_until=GREATEST(valid_until, DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 7 DAY)), locked_until=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND coupon_status IN ('locked', 'used')

UPDATE coupon_usage SET usage_status=#{status}, released_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='released' THEN #{now} ELSE released_at END, return_confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='returned' THEN #{now} ELSE return_confirmed_at END, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND usage_status IN ('locked', 'used')
UPDATE coupon_allocation SET allocation_status=#{status}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE coupon_usage_id=#{usage} AND allocation_status IN ('locked', 'effective')
